description: This file defines a class 'PinnedMessages' that manages pinned message indices within a session, storing this information in local storage. It includes methods for pinning, unpinning, toggling, and clearing pinned messages, as well as loading and saving the state.

classes.name: PinnedMessages
classes.description: Class to manage pinned message indices stored in local storage, with methods to modify and retrieve pinned message indices.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes a new instance with a session key, setting up the storage key and loading existing pinned message indices.

methods.name: indices
methods.description: Getter that returns the current set of pinned message indices.

methods.name: has
methods.description: Checks if a particular message index is pinned.

methods.name: pin
methods.description: Pins a message by adding its index to the set and saving the state.

methods.name: unpin
methods.description: Unpins a message by removing its index from the set and saving the state.

methods.name: toggle
methods.description: Toggles the pinned state of a message index.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads pinned message indices from local storage.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the current pinned message indices to local storage.
